free_tier.stated: Eight storage plans, all one vCPU, priced in euro with a promotional rate and a renewal rate printed side by side: 256 GB for EUR 2.22/month (renews EUR 4.45), 512 GB EUR 2.71 (EUR 5.42), 1 TB EUR 4.17 (EUR 8.35), 2 TB EUR 6.61 (EUR 13.22), 3 TB EUR 12.07 (EUR 24.14), 4 TB EUR 22.31 (EUR 44.62), 6 TB EUR 33.75 (EUR 67.49) and 8 TB EUR 67.50 (EUR 134.99). RAM runs 0.5 GB to 16 GB and transfer 2 TB to 64 TB with the plan.

egress.terms: 2 TB to 64 TB a month by plan, eight times the disk on every row
egress.free_allowance: 8 TB per month on the 1 TB plan

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
tooling: KVM guest with root and a 30-day money-back guarantee; ssh and rsync reach it
chaining: EUR 4.17 for the first terabyte is the cheapest euro first-terabyte, and the renewal at twice the price is the catch. The 64 TB of transfer on the 8 TB plan is what a mirror needs

limits.value: 8 TB a month on the 1 TB plan and 64 TB a month on the 8 TB plan, stated in the plan table. No overage price is printed.

limits_note: 8 TB a month on the 1 TB plan and 64 TB a month on the 8 TB plan, stated in the plan table. No overage price is printed.
binding_note: 8 TB a month on the 1 TB plan and 64 TB a month on the 8 TB plan, stated in the plan table. No overage price is printed.

evidence.proved: table quoted: '1 TB Plan | 8 TB | 2 GB | 1024 GB | 1 vCPU | No | EUR 11.99 -65% 4,17 EUR / month 8,35 EUR / month when you renew'
the largest row quoted: '8 TB Plan | 64 TB | 16 GB | 8192 GB | 1 vCPU | No | EUR 189.99 -64% 67,50 EUR / month 134,99 EUR / month when you renew'
every plan prints both figures, and the discounts run from 50 to 66 per cent, which is the widest promotional gap

notes: This is the only provider where the page prints the promotional rate and the renewal rate side by side for every plan, so the second year is not unknown here. Prices use a comma decimal on the page (4,17) and a point in this record.

benchmark.cpu_model: Intel Xeon E3-12xx v2 (Ivy Bridge, IBRS)
benchmark.note: Xeon E3-12xx v2 (Ivy Bridge). Slowest single core in the whole table by a factor of 8.7 against Aeza, on the same nominal standard of 2 vCPU.
